questions.q: Which DMV serves as the anchor for plan-cache queries, holding the handles needed to pull both text and plan?
options: sys.dm_exec_query_stats
sys.query_store_query
sys.dm_db_file_space_usage
sys.master_files
questions.explain: sys.dm_exec_query_stats has one row per cached plan along with plan_handle and sql_handle, the keys used to look up the plan and text.

questions.q: What does sys.dm_exec_query_plan take as input, and what does it return?
options: It takes a plan_handle and returns the actual XML execution plan
It takes a database name and returns a list of all tables
It takes a sql_handle and returns Query Store history
It takes no input and returns server-wide CPU usage
questions.explain: sys.dm_exec_query_plan resolves a plan_handle into the actual XML execution plan, viewable graphically in SSMS.

questions.q: What command clears the entire in-memory plan cache?
options: DBCC FREEPROCCACHE
DBCC CHECKDB
ALTER DATABASE ... SET QUERY_STORE = ON
sp_updatestats
questions.explain: DBCC FREEPROCCACHE clears the entire plan cache, or a single plan if given a specific plan_handle.

questions.q: Why might a query that ran heavily overnight show zero rows in sys.dm_exec_query_stats the next morning?
options: The plan cache is volatile — plans get evicted under memory pressure, on restart, or via certain schema changes
sys.dm_exec_query_stats only stores data older than 24 hours
The query must have failed to execute at all
sys.dm_exec_query_stats requires Query Store to be enabled first
questions.explain: Unlike Query Store, the plan cache lives entirely in memory and plans can be evicted at any time, so it only reflects what's currently cached.

questions.q: What is the key functional difference between the plan cache and Query Store, per this lesson?
options: The plan cache shows only what's currently in memory; Query Store persists history to disk and survives a restart
Query Store only works on Azure SQL Database, never on-premises SQL Server
The plan cache stores query text but never execution statistics
There is no real difference — they store identical data
questions.explain: The plan cache is in-memory and volatile; Query Store writes to disk, so it answers questions about performance over time that the plan cache cannot.
